APPROVE
The two loops move unchanged into `ReadEntries` and `EnqueueSubdirectories`, which removes roughly 24 of the 27 complexity points from `Files`; behaviour is preserved because the old `break` and the new `return` both end only the entries loop before subdirectories are enqueued, and the code should still build, though the moved `#pragma warning restore CHA0004` now also covers the two new helpers, which is worth checking.
